title: The Survival Standard
description: A vanilla-plus modpack that brings  tweaks and animation upgrades to Minecraft without changing much of survival gameplay.
body:
The Survival Standard is a vanilla-plus modpack. It adds smooth, thoughtful improvements that make survival feel better without changing what makes Minecraft… well, Minecraft.

It includes familiar favorites like Mouse Tweaks and AppleSkin, along with subtle animation enhancements and tweaks that make the game feel more alive. It’s not about overhauling the game — it’s about adding those little things that make everything click.

Expect cleaner interactions, and a world that just feels more polished — all without adding unnecessary bulk or complexity. Whether you’re diving into your first survival world or building your hundredth base, this pack is designed to keep things running smooth and feeling good.

Simple. Sharp. Satisfying.
That’s The Survival Standard.
